{"description": "Mutation loop for batcher", "subagent_type": "general-purpose", "model": "sonnet", "run_in_background": false, "prompt": "You are running a mutation-testing loop in the git worktree at:
<runs>/new2/run-1/work

Target: src/digest/batcher.py (function plan_sends). Tests: tests/test_batcher.py.
Test command (run from the worktree root): `python3 -B -m unittest tests.test_batcher -q 2>&1 | tail -15`
Always use `-B` and also `export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1` so no stale .pyc can mask a mutant.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Digests batch notifications by recipient.
2. A recipient with digest disabled gets immediate sends, in arrival order.
3. A recipient's batch holds at most 50 items; larger batches split.

Apply each mutation below ONE AT A TIME, run the test command, record whether a test went red (and which test name), then restore with `git checkout -- src/digest/batcher.py` before the next one. Do not edit tests. Mutations:
M1 (crit 1): group everything under one key — change `grouped[n.recipient].append(n)` to `grouped["all"].append(n)`.
M2 (crit 1): change `digests.append((rid, items[i:i + MAX_BATCH]))` to `digests.append((rid, items[i:i + MAX_BATCH][::-1]))` (order within batch).
M3 (crit 2): flip condition `not r.digest_enabled` -> `r.digest_enabled`.
M4 (crit 2): drop `continue` after `immediate.append(n)`.
M5 (crit 2): `return digests, immediate` -> `return digests, list(reversed(immediate))`.
M6 (crit 2): `return digests, immediate` -> `return digests, sorted(immediate, key=lambda n: n.recipient)`.
M7 (crit 3): `MAX_BATCH = 50` -> `MAX_BATCH = 51`.
M8 (crit 3): `MAX_BATCH = 50` -> `MAX_BATCH = 49`.
M9 (crit 3): replace the inner for-loop body/range so it doesn't split: `for i in range(0, len(items), MAX_BATCH):` -> `for i in range(0, 1):` and slice `items[i:i + MAX_BATCH]` -> `items`.
M10 (crit 3): `items[i:i + MAX_BATCH]` -> `items[i:i + MAX_BATCH - 1]`.
M11 (unknown-recipient branch): `if r is not None and not r.digest_enabled:` -> `if r is None or not r.digest_enabled:`.
M12: `return digests, immediate` -> `return digests[:1], immediate`.

When done: run `git checkout -- src/digest/batcher.py`, delete any `__pycache__` dirs (`find . -name __pycache__ -prune -exec rm -rf {} +`), and confirm `git status --short` is empty. Run the test command once more to confirm it passes on the restored code.

Return ONLY a compact table: one line per mutation: `M<n> | crit | KILLED by <test name>` or `M<n> | crit | SURVIVED`, followed by the final `git status --short` output and the final test result line."}
